user.title: Irrigation Maestro
user.description: Let's start with the basics. Only a weather entity is required — you can skip the optional sensors and add them later. After this you'll add your zones one by one.

data_description.weather_entity: Required. A weather.* entity that provides temperature and precipitation forecasts (e.g. Met.no).
data_description.rain_sensor: A sensor reporting today's total rainfall in mm. If empty, rainfall is estimated from the forecast.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Use a real thermometer instead of the weather entity for the daily temperature maxima.
data_description.line_flow_sensor: A single flow meter (L/min) on the manifold, shared by zones that don't have their own.
data_description.master_valve: A valve or switch (e.g. a pump relay) opened before the first zone and closed after the last.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance of Irrigation Maestro is possible.

general.title: General
general.description: The weather source and optional hardware shared by every zone. Only the weather entity is required; leave the rest empty if you don't have it.

data_description.weather_entity: Required. A weather.* entity that provides temperature and precipitation forecasts (e.g. Met.no).
data_description.rain_sensor: A sensor reporting today's total rainfall in mm. If empty, rainfall is estimated from the forecast.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Use a real thermometer instead of the weather entity for the daily temperature maxima.
data_description.line_flow_sensor: A single flow meter (L/min) on the manifold, shared by zones that don't have their own.
data_description.master_valve: A valve or switch (e.g. a pump relay) opened before the first zone and closed after the last.
data_description.master_pre_open_s: How long the master valve/pump runs before the first zone opens, to build pressure. Default 5.
data_description.master_post_close_s: How long the master valve/pump keeps running after the last zone closes. Default 5.
data_description.max_concurrent: How many zones may water together. Keep 1 unless your water pressure can feed more at once.
data_description.compatibility_groups: Only needed if the maximum above is more than 1. Comma-separated names (e.g. 'drip, lawn'); only zones you assign to the same group may run together.

safety.title: Safety & timing
safety.description: Timeouts and safety windows for opening and closing valves. The defaults are safe for most setups — change them only if your hardware needs it.

data_description.settle_pause_s: Pause between one zone closing and the next opening, to let pressure settle. Default 120.
data_description.manual_block_min: After you stop watering by hand, automatic programs stay blocked for this long. Default 60.
data_description.watchdog_max_min: Safety cap: a valve open longer than this is force-closed and reported. Default 70.
data_description.open_confirm_s: If a valve doesn't report 'open' within this time, the program is cancelled. Default 120.
data_description.close_confirm_s: If a valve doesn't confirm 'closed' within this time, it retries and alerts you. Default 120.
data_description.switch_confirm_s: For switch-based valves (no position feedback): assumed open/closed after this delay. Default 10.
data_description.wait_free_min: A due program waits at most this long for the other valves to be free before being skipped. Default 10.
data_description.startup_valve_timeout_s: After a restart, how long to wait for valves to come back online before reporting one unreachable. Default 300.
data_description.sentinel_time: Time of the daily check that alerts you if a scheduled program never ran. Default 12:00.
data_description.session_max_min: Optional. Skip any zones still queued once a watering session has run this many minutes. Empty = no limit.
data_description.must_finish_by: Optional. Don't start a program that would finish after this time of day. Empty = no limit.

engine_advanced.title: Engine (advanced)
engine_advanced.description: Weights and thresholds of the watering decision engine. Only change these if you know what you are doing — 'Reset to defaults' restores the field-validated values.

data_description.temp_weights: Five comma-separated weights: day −3, day −2, yesterday, today, tomorrow. Default 0.05, 0.15, 0.3, 0.35, 0.15.
data_description.rain_weights: Four comma-separated weights: today, yesterday, day −2, day −3. Default 0.85, 0.5, 0.2, 0.05.
data_description.forecast_credit_weights: Two comma-separated weights: rain forecast 0–24 h and 24–48 h. Default 0.6, 0.25.
data_description.forecast_credit_cap_mm: Most credit forecast rain can contribute to the budget. Default 5.
data_description.hot_credit_halving_temp_c: At or above this weighted temperature, forecast rain credit is halved (summer storms often miss). Default 30.
data_description.threshold_base_mm: Base rain amount that makes a session skip. Default 3.
data_description.threshold_slope_mm_per_c: How much the skip threshold rises per °C above the knee below. Default 0.5.
data_description.threshold_knee_c: Weighted temperature above which the threshold starts rising. Default 28.
data_description.threshold_max_mm: Upper cap for the skip threshold. Default 6.
data_description.freeze_skip_c: Skip watering when the current temperature is below this (frost risk). Default 2.
data_description.cold_day_skip_c: Skip when today's effective maximum stays below this. Default 10.
data_description.wind_skip_enabled: Also skip watering when the wind is above the speed below. Off by default.
data_description.wind_skip_kmh: Wind speed that triggers a skip when the option above is on. Default 30.
data_description.staged_rain_weight: Forecast-only rain is counted at this fraction (never full weight). Default 0.8.
data_description.stage_commit_minute: Minute of each hour when the ending hour's forecast rain is committed. Default 55.
data_description.daily_rain_cap_mm: Safety cap on the tracked daily rainfall. Default 200.
data_description.hourly_staging_cap_mm: Safety cap on a single hour's estimated rainfall. Default 50.
data_description.season_months: Months in which watering is considered at all. Default March–October. Zones can override this.
data_description.stale_weather_max_h: Hours without a weather update before the data counts as stale. Default 6.
data_description.stale_weather_policy: When weather is stale: 'Water anyway' uses the last known temperature (budget 0); 'Skip watering' skips.
data_description.reset_to_defaults: Discard every value on this page and restore the built-in, field-validated defaults.

restrictions.title: Calendar restrictions
restrictions.description: Optional rules for municipal or consortium watering ordinances. Leave everything empty if you have no restrictions. Zones can override these individually.

data_description.allowed_weekdays: Water only on the selected days. Leave empty to allow every day.
data_description.parity: Restrict watering to odd or even days of the month (some ordinances alternate by house number).
data_description.forbidden_windows: Times when watering is not allowed, e.g. '08:00-10:30, 22:00-23:15'. Empty = no forbidden times. A running program is cut short rather than run into one.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Pick the event to configure; the next step sets its targets and priority.

data_description.enabled: Turn off to keep this event silent.
data_description.services: One or more notify.* services (e.g. your phone app) that receive this event.
data_description.priority: High marks urgent events (anomalies, watchdog) as high-importance on supported apps.

consumption_budget.title: Consumption budget
consumption_budget.description: Optional monthly water cap. Leave the budget empty to disable it entirely.

data_description.liters_per_month: Total litres allowed per calendar month. Empty = no budget. Needs a flow meter, or nominal flow rates to estimate use.
data_description.action: What happens once the budget is used up: notify only warns, reduce shortens every program, suspend stops watering until next month.
data_description.reduce_pct: By how much each program is shortened when the action is 'Reduce watering'. Default 50.

error.invalid_time_window: Windows must look like '08:00-10:30', separated by commas.

user.title: New zone
user.description: One irrigation circuit: its valve and how often it waters. Only the name and the valve are required — you'll set the watering amount (the curve) after adding a program in the next step.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this circuit, e.g. 'Vegetable beds' or 'Front lawn'.
data_description.icon: Icon shown for this zone's device. Leave empty for the default.
data_description.valve_entity: Required. The valve.* or switch.* entity that opens this circuit — any device or helper, not only Zigbee.
data_description.flow_sensor: This zone's own flow meter (L/min). If empty, the shared line meter is used when available.
data_description.nominal_flow_lpm: Expected flow while watering; enables leak / no-flow / out-of-range detection. Needs a flow meter.
data_description.flow_tolerance_pct: How far the real flow may stray from the nominal value before it's flagged. Default 25.
data_description.area_m2: Circuit surface, used only to show minutes ↔ mm conversions. Optional.
data_description.adjustment_pct: Scales every watering time up or down (e.g. 70 for a shaded bed, 130 for a sunny one). 100 = unchanged.
data_description.order: Watering sequence: lower numbers water first. Default 100.
data_description.interval_days: Water at most every N days (1–60). 1 = every day, 3 = every third day. Default 3.
data_description.compatibility_group: Only used when the hub allows more than one concurrent zone. Zones in the same group may run together.
data_description.season_months: Water only in these months, overriding the hub season. Empty = follow the hub (March–October).

data_description.name: A friendly name for this circuit, e.g. 'Vegetable beds' or 'Front lawn'.
data_description.icon: Icon shown for this zone's device. Leave empty for the default.
data_description.valve_entity: Required. The valve.* or switch.* entity that opens this circuit — any device or helper, not only Zigbee.
data_description.flow_sensor: This zone's own flow meter (L/min). If empty, the shared line meter is used when available.

data_description.order: Watering sequence: lower numbers water first. Default 100.
data_description.interval_days: Water at most every N days (1–60). 1 = every day, 3 = every third day. Default 3.

data_description.season_months: Water only in these months, overriding the hub season. Empty = follow the hub (March–October).

cycle_menu.title: Programs of {zone_name}
cycle_menu.description: Configured programs: {cycles}. At least one program is required.

cycle.title: Program
cycle.description: A program is one daily watering run for this zone. A zone can have several (e.g. one in the morning and one in the evening), each with its own start time and curve.

data_description.name: A name for this run, e.g. 'Morning' or 'Evening'.
data_description.kind: Start at sunrise/sunset (with an offset) or at a fixed clock time.
data_description.months_override: Run this program only in certain months. Empty = follow the zone's season.

cycle_sun.title: Sun trigger
cycle_sun.description: Start this program relative to sunrise or sunset — it follows the season automatically through the year.

data_description.event: Anchor the start to sunrise or to sunset.
data_description.offset_min: Minutes before (negative) or after (positive) the event. E.g. −60 = one hour before sunrise. Max ±360.

cycle_time.title: Time trigger
cycle_time.description: Start this program at the same clock time every day.

data_description.at: The time of day this program starts, e.g. 06:30.

cycle_curve.title: Watering curve
cycle_curve.description: The curve decides how long (or how much) to water based on the weighted temperature: hotter days water more. Start from a ready-made preset, copy one from another program, or build your own.

data_description.source: 'Potted plants' and 'Lawn' are ready-made presets; 'Custom' lets you enter your own points; 'Copy' reuses a curve from an existing program.
data_description.soak_max_run_min: Optional. To avoid runoff on slow-draining soil, split watering into runs no longer than this. Empty = water in one go.
data_description.soak_pause_min: Absorption pause between those runs; other zones can water in the meantime.
data_description.volume_safety_timeout_min: Volume curves only: force the valve closed after this long if the target litres are never measured.

cycle_curve_custom.title: Custom curve
cycle_curve_custom.description: Define control points mapping weighted temperature to a watering amount. Between points the value is interpolated; outside them it stays flat.

data_description.points: 'temperature:value' pairs with increasing temperatures, e.g. '10:5, 25:15, 35:30' means 5 min at 10°C up to 30 min at 35°C.
data_description.min_value: Never water less than this (applied after the zone adjustment).
data_description.max_value: Never water more than this (applied after the zone adjustment).
data_description.kind: What the values mean: minutes (duration) or litres (volume). Volume needs a usable flow meter.

data_description.source: Pick an existing zone/program to copy its curve into this program. You can adjust it afterwards.

error.interval_out_of_range: The interval must be between 1 and 60 days.
error.offset_out_of_range: The offset must be within ±360 minutes.
error.curve_empty: Enter at least one control point.
error.curve_negative_value: Point values must not be negative.
error.curve_temps_not_increasing: Point temperatures must be strictly increasing.
error.min_above_max: The minimum must not exceed the maximum.
error.negative_clamp: The minimum must not be negative.
error.duration_out_of_range: Durations must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
error.volume_requires_flow: Volume curves need a zone flow sensor or a line flow sensor on the hub.
error.soak_pause_without_max: A soak pause needs a maximum run time as well.
error.copy_source_missing: That program no longer exists — pick another one.

run_zone.name: Run zone
run_zone.description: Waters one zone now. Decision gates (cadence, budget, season) are bypassed; safety gates still apply.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone id (the zone_id attribute of the zone's entities).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Watering duration in minutes. If omitted, the program curve decides.

run_all.name: Run all zones
run_all.description: Waters every enabled, non-suspended zone now, in the configured order.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to skip. Omit to skip every zone.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Pauses automatic watering for a number of hours.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to pause. Omit to pause globally.

suspend_until.name: Suspend until
suspend_until.description: Suspends automatic watering until a date and time.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to suspend. Omit to suspend every zone.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to resume. Omit to clear the global pause and every zone.

stop_all.name: Stop all
stop_all.description: Closes every valve, cancels the queue and blocks automatic watering for the configured window.

evaluate.name: Evaluate
evaluate.description: Runs one engine evaluation and returns the full watering plan as the response.

set_zone_order.name: Set zone order
set_zone_order.description: Changes a zone's watering priority (zones water in ascending order).

set_curve.name: Set curve
set_curve.description: Replaces a program's watering curve with inline control points.

cycle_id.name: Program
cycle_id.description: The program whose curve is replaced.

points.name: Control points
points.description: List of [temperature, value] pairs with strictly increasing temperatures.

min_value.name: Minimum
min_value.description: Lower clamp. If omitted, the current minimum is kept.

max_value.name: Maximum
max_value.description: Upper clamp. If omitted, the current maximum is kept.

set_simple_curve.name: Set simple curve
set_simple_curve.description: Builds a duration curve from a base amount and a hot-day boost, then saves it to a program.

cycle_id.name: Program
cycle_id.description: The program whose curve is set.

amount.name: Amount (min at 25°)
amount.description: Watering minutes on a mild day.

heat.name: Hot-day boost (extra min at 35°)
heat.description: Extra minutes on a hot day vs a mild one.

export_config.name: Export configuration
export_config.description: Returns the hub options and every zone's configuration as a JSON string.

import_config.name: Import configuration
import_config.description: Applies a previously exported configuration to the hub and its existing zones.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: The JSON string produced by export_config.

set_program_schedule.name: Set program schedule
set_program_schedule.description: Sets the days and start time of a program.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone the program belongs to.

days.name: Days
days.description: Weekdays it runs (Monday–Sunday). Leave empty for every day.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: When it starts, for a fixed-time start.

start_event.name: Sun event
start_event.description: Sunrise or sunset, for a sun start.

start_offset_min.name: Offset (min)
start_offset_min.description: Minutes before (−) or after (+) the sun event.

set_program_minutes.name: Set program minutes
set_program_minutes.description: Sets a program's watering minutes, either the same every day or per weekday. Not available for volume-target programs.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone the program belongs to.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Same watering minutes every scheduled day. Exclusive with per-day minutes.

day_minutes.name: Per-day minutes
day_minutes.description: Minutes per weekday (0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday), e.g. Monday 15, Wednesday 20. Exclusive with minutes.

add_program.name: Add program
add_program.description: Adds a new program to a zone, optionally copied from an existing one.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to add the program to.

name.name: Name
name.description: The new program's name. Defaults to 'Program', or the source name followed by ' (copy)' when copying.

copy_from.name: Copy from
copy_from.description: An existing program on the same zone to copy the schedule and curve from.

remove_program.name: Remove program
remove_program.description: Removes a program from a zone. A zone must keep at least one program.

add_zone.name: Add zone
add_zone.description: Creates a new zone with a default watering program, in place with no reload required. Returns the new zone's id as the response.

name.name: Name
name.description: A friendly name for this circuit, e.g. Vegetable beds or Front lawn.

valve_entity.name: Valve
valve_entity.description: The valve or switch entity that opens this circuit.

area_m2.name: Area (m²)
area_m2.description: Circuit surface, used only to show minutes to mm conversions. Optional.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon shown for this zone's device. Leave empty for the default.

update_zone.name: Update zone
update_zone.description: Updates one or more of a zone's settings in place; only the provided fields change.

name.name: Name
name.description: A friendly name for this circuit, e.g. Vegetable beds or Front lawn.

valve_entity.name: Valve
valve_entity.description: The valve or switch entity that opens this circuit.

area_m2.name: Area (m²)
area_m2.description: Circuit surface, used only to show minutes to mm conversions.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon shown for this zone's device.

flow_sensor.name: Flow sensor
flow_sensor.description: This zone's own flow meter (L/min). If empty, the shared line meter is used when available.

nominal_flow_lpm.name: Nominal flow (L/min)
nominal_flow_lpm.description: Expected flow while watering; enables leak, no-flow and out-of-range detection. Needs a flow meter.

flow_tolerance_pct.name: Flow tolerance (%)
flow_tolerance_pct.description: How far the real flow may stray from the nominal value before it's flagged.

adjustment_pct.name: Adjustment (%)
adjustment_pct.description: Scales every watering time up or down. 100 means unchanged.

order.name: Order
order.description: Watering sequence: lower numbers water first.

interval_days.name: Watering interval (days)
interval_days.description: Water at most every N days, from 1 to 60.

compatibility_group.name: Compatibility group
compatibility_group.description: Only used when the hub allows more than one concurrent zone. Zones in the same group may run together.

season_months.name: Season months override
season_months.description: Water only in these months, overriding the hub season. Leave empty to follow the hub.

remove_zone.name: Remove zone
remove_zone.description: Deletes a zone and its programs in place, with no reload required.

set_weather_sources.name: Set weather and sensors
set_weather_sources.description: Sets the hub's weather entity and optional shared sensors in place, with no reload required.

weather_entity.name: Weather entity
weather_entity.description: Required. A weather entity that provides temperature and precipitation forecasts.

rain_sensor.name: Rain sensor
rain_sensor.description: A sensor reporting today's total rainfall in mm. Leave empty to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

outdoor_temp_sensor.name: Outdoor temperature sensor
outdoor_temp_sensor.description: Use a real thermometer instead of the weather entity for the daily temperature maxima. Leave empty to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

line_flow_sensor.name: Line flow sensor
line_flow_sensor.description: A single flow meter (L/min) on the manifold, shared by zones that don't have their own. Leave empty to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

master_valve.name: Master valve / pump
master_valve.description: A valve or switch opened before the first zone and closed after the last. Leave empty to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

set_consumption_budget.name: Set consumption budget
set_consumption_budget.description: Sets the hub's monthly water cap and what happens once it is exceeded, in place.

liters_per_month.name: Monthly budget (liters)
liters_per_month.description: Total liters allowed per calendar month. Omit or set to zero to disable the budget.

action.name: Action when exceeded
action.description: What happens once the budget is used up: notify only warns, reduce shortens every program, suspend stops watering until next month.

reduce_pct.name: Reduction percentage
reduce_pct.description: By how much each program is shortened when the action is reduce watering.

set_restrictions.name: Set restrictions
set_restrictions.description: Sets the hub's calendar watering restrictions in place, with no reload required.

allowed_weekdays.name: Allowed weekdays
allowed_weekdays.description: Water only on the selected days. Leave empty to allow every day.

parity.name: Day-of-month parity
parity.description: Restrict watering to odd or even days of the month, or none for no restriction.

forbidden_windows.name: Forbidden time windows
forbidden_windows.description: Times when watering is not allowed. Empty means no forbidden times. A running program is cut short rather than run into one.

weather_unavailable.title: Weather data unavailable
weather_unavailable.description: The weather data could not be fetched at evaluation time. The configured stale-weather policy was applied. Check the weather integration and the configured weather entity.

close_failed.title: Valve did not close
close_failed.description: The valve {entity_id} did not confirm closure after a retry. The watchdog keeps trying; if water still flows, close the supply manually and check the valve hardware.

valve_unreachable.title: Valve unreachable
valve_unreachable.description: The valve {entity_id} has been unavailable for too long. Zones using it cannot water; check its power and radio connection.

sentinel_missing_outcome.title: Scheduled watering did not run
sentinel_missing_outcome.description: No outcome was recorded today for: {cycles}. The trigger probably never fired (Home Assistant was off at trigger time, or an unexpected error occurred).

invalid_points.message: Invalid curve points ({error}): temperatures must be strictly increasing and values must not be negative.

min_above_max.message: The minimum must not exceed the maximum.

simple_curve_on_volume.message: Simple curves are duration-only; this program uses a volume curve. Edit it in the zone settings.

invalid_payload.message: The payload is not a valid exported configuration.

unknown_import_zone.message: The payload references a zone that does not exist: {zone_id}.

start_time_required.message: A fixed-time start needs a start_time (HH:MM).

start_event_required.message: A sun start needs a start_event (sunrise or sunset).

cannot_remove_last_program.message: A zone must keep at least one program.
